description: With a limit of 3 tasks per phase, Phase 1 (three requirements with a token store, expiry, email, deadline, and verify) cannot fit. The skill stops in one line, sends the user to write-plan, and writes no tasks.

must_match.why: phase sizes are fixed in the plan

must_not_match.why: no tasks are squeezed under the limit

expectations: The reply does not merge unrelated work into fewer tasks and does not split the phase itself.
